integrity: The radial ambiguity identities follow from exact Gaussian integrals, the optimizer from an unrestricted calculus proof, and the independent quadrature/symbolic/numerical checker supports but does not replace that proof. Publication priority beyond the inspected literature is not certified.
limitations: The exact maximin result applies to fixed real-unit-normalized Hermite windows of orders 0 and 1 and arbitrary additive errors in Fourier-transformed squared-STFT channels on disks. It is not global signal-reconstruction stability, nor optimality among other windows.
title: Sharp two-Hermite measurement budgeting on a Fourier-ambiguity disk
